rationale: The agent made several source edits to adapt to Vert.x 5.0.0 API changes, but the verifier's install command failed with a code-format validation error: 'VertxContext.java is not correctly formatted'. This is a concrete compiler/build-gate failure caused by the agent's edits not matching the project's enforced code style, preventing the build from completing. The agent's own trajectory shows the build succeeded only when the format plugin was skipped, but the verifier runs without that skip flag.

evidence.quote: [ERROR] Failed to execute goal com.cosium.code:git-code-format-maven-plugin:5.3:validate-code-format (validate-code-format) on project sqrl-server-vertx-base: /app/sqrl-server/sqrl-server-vertx-base/src/main/java/com/datasqrl/graphql/VertxContext.java is not correctly formatted !
